title: Patch: a Radiant Mid Loser cast onto a full board keeps its Lucky
notes: Issue #3835 (R1440, R1438): C+ #19.3 Mid Loser's coin read its own Lucky only while it stood on the field, so a Radiant one cast with every unit zone full, its Cry running from the resolving zone (R1), flipped once instead of twice. It now reads lucky_on wherever its Cry runs, as Conjure's and Ace in the Hole's coins do. The script it replaces is kept under v0.6.2b (KEPT_SCRIPTS, R767000). No catalog change.

player.title: Mid Loser keeps its Lucky
fixes: A Radiant Mid Loser cast while every unit zone is full now flips its coin twice, as its Lucky says.
